thesis: Pre-open news pack for 2026-09-02 contains diverse, diffuse items without actionable fundamental conviction for portfolio rotation. High-profile headlines include legal/regulatory actions (FTC lawsuit against Amazon over ad surcharges), routine politician transaction filings, speculative cryptocurrency price projections, and broad macroeconomic commentary (Bill Gates on automation displacement, oil infrastructure investment amid Middle East tensions, and OpenAI run-rate chatter). Single-name items (PG&E, Meta teen safety, Tesla event run-up) do not present high-conviction catalysts justifying capital re-allocation under a balanced mandate. Holding our current 4-position book—anchored by core equity VTI, fixed-income ballast BND, and growth/semiconductor exposure in NVDA and XLK—maintains proper diversification (cap 6), keeps single names well within the 35% cap (largest is VTI at ~28%), and preserves $35.00 cash (~32% of equity, comfortably exceeding the 15% floor) without incurring needless churn.
